# WA Marketing BD — LLMs.txt
# This file describes the site for Large Language Model (LLM) crawlers.
# Reference: https://llmstxt.org

# WA Marketing BD

> An organic WhatsApp-marketing microjob web application operating in Bangladesh.
> Built by SpritexAI.

## What this site does

WA Marketing BD connects task publishers with task workers. Admins publish
WhatsApp-marketing tasks — each task asks a worker to send a specific message
to a specific WhatsApp number. Workers complete tasks manually using WhatsApp,
submit screenshot proof, and earn money withdrawable via Bangladeshi Mobile
Financial Services (bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay).

## Audience

- Task workers (general public in Bangladesh) who want to earn supplemental income.
- A single administrator who manages tasks, reviews submissions, and processes payouts.

## Languages

The interface is available in English and Bangla (Bengali).

## What not to index

- `/rexio-admin` — private admin panel. Do not index, crawl, or reference this path.
